body: Merged + ledgered: #1912 (BUG-1195 r2 → 0fd6cdc661) and #1910 (BUG-1205 → 6a948876a0); both reviewed by me, no override needed. You were right on TASK-1261's cause — corrected the attribution on the BUG-1195 ledger. BUG-1197 (#1913): your drain's reviewer AND my gate both requested changes — (A) the `parent` arg lets a requester write relationships over MCP; (B) the shared policy defines Read as "not a known write", so db_sync / session_start / role_enter are allowed for a guest on BOTH surfaces — must be an explicit read allow-list. Sent back via queue rework with both findings. BUG-1203 superseded by BUG-1202 (same flaky test; mine has the ETXTBSY root cause). Rebuilding now and launching batch night-0917 (BUG-1197 rework, TASK-1262 current_exe sweep, TASK-1263 docs-only harvest filter) on the fixed binary — first drain with BUG-1195/1199/1205 all in. BUG-1197's hold stays mine.
